Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to correctly identify the first National Geographic short on YouTube. Instead of confirming the title of the first short released, WebSurfer incorrectly identified "Human Origins 101" as the first short, which led the entire conversation down the wrong path. The correct short referenced as the first National Geographic short on YouTube was not verified, and consequently, the identification of #9 and its associated maximum length in meters was entirely misdirected. This initial error cascaded through the conversation, preventing the team from arriving at the correct solution.
